questions.label: 改动范围
questions.question: How much of the codebase does the change touch?

options.label: 小
options.text: one file or a local edit

options.label: 跨模块
options.text: several modules, a contract between them, or a migration

questions.label: 需求
questions.question: Can the requirement be acted on as written?

options.label: 清楚
options.text: yes, the goal and acceptance are stated

options.label: 模糊
options.text: no, the goal or acceptance is open to interpretation

questions.label: 出错代价
questions.question: What does getting it wrong cost?

options.label: 低
options.text: cheap to get wrong and easy to undo

options.label: 中
options.text: a real cost, but contained and recoverable

options.label: 高
options.text: data loss, money, security, outward-facing or irreversible effects

questions.label: 要人拍板
questions.question: Does a person have to make a decision the ticket does not already contain?

options.label: 否
options.text: no, the ticket already contains every decision

options.label: 是
options.text: yes, a person has to decide something first or at acceptance

rules.label: 小改动、需求清楚、代价低
